items.name: button
items.title: Minecraft Button
items.description: Minecraft Button with original textures, ASCII/Unihex glyphs and click sound. Native default variant and size; scale, refs, native props and render supported. 66 ASCII plus 96 fixed CJK native cases at scales 1–3. Other glyphs and scrolling labels remain unverified.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Minecraft Checkbox
items.description: Vanilla Minecraft Checkbox appearance with standard Base UI/shadcn behavior. Native-reference matrix covers boolean states at scales 1–3; mixed state is a web composition.

items.name: slider
items.title: Minecraft Slider
items.description: Original Minecraft slider track/handle, logical-pixel position rounding, and ASCII labels with standard shadcn/Base UI values and events. Native matrix: 225 single-thumb horizontal cases at scales 1–3. Range/RTL/vertical are web extensions.

items.name: input
items.title: Minecraft Input
items.description: Vanilla Minecraft EditBox on a real HTML input: original textures, ASCII/Unihex pixels, caret, selection and clipping. 306 ASCII plus 72 fixed CJK native cases at scales 1–3. Other glyphs and raster environments remain unverified; unsupported types retain browser rendering.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Minecraft Tooltip
items.description: Original Minecraft tooltip background/frame and ASCII glyphs with Base UI tooltip behavior. Native comparisons cover 180 composited cases at scales 1–3, fixed screen geometry and solid backdrops. Complex backdrops and other browser/GPU environments are unverified.

items.name: card
items.title: Minecraft Card
items.description: Original Minecraft popup panel with native nine-slice tiling, bold ASCII titles, wrapped descriptions and 18/12 logical-pixel spacing. Standard Card section APIs; arbitrary card layouts remain web compositions. 96 native reference cases at scales 1–3.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Minecraft Textarea
items.description: Original Minecraft multiline editor surface, glyphs, caret, selection and scrollbar on a real HTML textarea. 72 ASCII plus 42 fixed CJK native cases at scales 1–3. Other glyph sampling and character-limit decorations remain unverified.

items.name: label
items.title: Minecraft Label
items.description: Minecraft StringWidget and MultiLineTextWidget appearance with accessible Base UI label association, original ASCII/Unihex glyphs, native 9-pixel line spacing, wrapping and centering. 84 native cases at scales 1–3; other glyphs and raster environments remain unverified.

items.name: separator
items.title: Minecraft Separator
items.description: Original Minecraft menu header/footer separator textures, native horizontal orientation and 2-pixel height, with Base UI semantic/decorative behavior, refs and render composition. 108 repeated native cases at scales1–3; vertical orientation is unsupported.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Minecraft Scroll Area
items.description: Minecraft vertical scrollbar and borderless clipped viewport with original scroller textures and native integer thumb geometry. Base UI viewport preserves native browser scrolling; refs, custom ScrollBar and render composition supported. 297 repeatable native cases at scales1–3. Horizontal and hover-only variants are unsupported.

items.name: progress
items.title: Minecraft Progress
items.description: Original Minecraft boss-bar appearance, all7 colors and5 notch styles, native182x5 geometry and float/discrete fill arithmetic. Original PNG and RGBA assets; notches use native source-alpha GPU blending. Base UI value/max semantics, labels, refs and render. 1284 steady-state native cases at scales1–3; arbitrary resizing and interpolation remain unverified.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Minecraft Tabs
items.description: Original Minecraft horizontal menu tabs, four native sprites, selected underline, timed overflowing labels and menu panel texture. Base UI selection, keyboard navigation, refs and composition. 822 repeated native cases at GUI scales1-3; fixed CJK glyph sampling context. Default visual variant only.

items.name: select
items.title: Minecraft Select
items.description: Original Minecraft cycle-button trigger with original language-selection-list surface and scrollbar. Base UI dropdown semantics, forms, refs, composition and CJK labels; 942 repeatable native surface cases at scales1-3. Native default trigger size only; popup behavior and optional grouping are web composition.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Minecraft Radio Group
items.description: Exclusive selection using original Minecraft Checkbox artwork and full21x17 empty-label widget bounds. Base UI keyboard navigation, forms, controlled values, refs and render; original click audio. 48 repeatable native item cases at GUI scales1-3 on two backgrounds. Group layout and exclusive selection are web composition; no circular radio variant.

items.name: switch
items.title: Minecraft Switch
items.description: Original Minecraft CycleButton ON/OFF appearance with shadcn/Base UI switch semantics. Original sprites, English value labels, click audio, refs, forms and render composition. Default150x20 native button, 192 repeated native cases at four widths and GUI scales1-3 on two backgrounds. Default visual size only.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Original Minecraft PopupScreen appearance with shadcn Dialog semantics.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Original ConfirmScreen appearance with accessible shadcn confirmation semantics.

items.name: popover
items.title: Minecraft Popover
items.description: Original Minecraft popup surface and typography, with shadcn/Base UI anchoring and interactive web behavior. 156 native appearance cases at scales 1-3; fixed CJK glyphs, original textures and click sound.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Minecraft Dropdown Menu
items.description: Shadcn/Base UI menu semantics with original Minecraft popup, suggestion-row typography, checkbox/radio and separator artwork. Fifteen standard exports, original click sound and fixed ASCII/CJK native appearance cases. Default visual variant only.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Minecraft Context Menu
items.description: Shadcn/Base UI context menu semantics with original Minecraft popup, suggestion rows, checkbox textures, font and separators. Fifteen exports; original checkbox/radio click sound. General menu layout is a designed composition.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Minecraft Menubar
items.description: Sixteen standard shadcn/Base UI menubar exports with original Button triggers, popup and suggestion-row surfaces, checkbox textures, glyphs, separators and click audio. Menubar geometry is a designed web composition. Default visual variant only.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Minecraft Collapsible
items.description: Three standard shadcn Collapsible exports with original Button appearance, normal/CJK text, native wrapping and click audio. Open-content layout is a designed web composition.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Minecraft Toggle
items.description: Original Minecraft recipe-book filter textures with shadcn pressed-state semantics. Native 26 by 16 logical pixels at scales 1–3; default variant and size only. Optional web children are a composition outside the native icon-only pixel claim.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Minecraft Toggle Group
items.description: Base UI single/multiple Toggle Group using original recipe-book filter artwork. Group geometry and optional children are web composition; default visual variant/size only.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Minecraft Aspect Ratio
items.description: Unskinned Base UI ratio layout; preserves child artwork without resampling. Web geometry verified separately from native skin fidelity.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Minecraft Button Group
items.description: Horizontal/vertical web grouping of original native Button and Label skins. Default button visuals only. Group geometry and rotated vertical separator are designed compositions.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Minecraft Pagination
items.description: Original recipe-book12×17 page arrows and original Button-skinned numeric links, bitmap fonts and native click audio; accessible web pagination semantics. Arrow and numeric-link cases are independently verified; web arrangement is a composition.

items.name: badge
items.title: Minecraft Badge
items.description: Original vanilla advancement frames, panel and diamond artwork with challenge/goal/task and earned/locked states.18 native117x26 reference cases at GUI scales1–3; compact sizing, CJK wrapping and link focus are web adaptations.

items.name: typography
items.title: Minecraft Typography
items.description: Semantic HTML typography with original vanilla ASCII/Unihex glyphs, shadow, wrapping and alignment. Headings retain native font scale; semantic hierarchy and prose layout are web compositions.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Minecraft Breadcrumb
items.description: Accessible shadcn breadcrumb navigation using original vanilla ASCII/Unihex text. Navigation, separators and ellipsis layout are a web composition.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Minecraft Kbd
items.description: Semantic kbd and KbdGroup using original native key-binding button treatment and glyphs, without activation handlers or audio. Keycap grouping is a web composition.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Minecraft Sheet
items.description: Original popup surface and native text constituents in an explicitly designed sheet composition. Native variants only.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Minecraft Drawer
items.description: Original popup surface and native text constituents in an explicitly designed drawer composition. Native variants only.

items.name: empty
items.title: Minecraft Empty
items.description: Original WorldSelectionList.NoWorldsEntry empty-row text placement with shadcn Empty composition slots, original ASCII/Unihex text and no invented media variants. Scalar children use the original native empty-row layout; rich slot composition remains a web layout.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Minecraft Resizable
items.description: Accessible split panels with opposing original recipe-book page arrows, direction-correct resize cursors, keyboard controls and percentage feedback.60 native arrow constituent cases; divider arrangement and rotated vertical controls are web compositions.

items.name: command
items.title: Minecraft Command
items.description: Base UI Autocomplete search, groups, shortcuts and dialog semantics with original EditBox, suggestion rows and popup skins. Palette arrangement is a web composition; native equality limited to declared constituent cases.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Minecraft Sidebar
items.description: The25standard shadcn Sidebar exports with original Button/Input/Popup/Label/Separator/ScrollArea/Tooltip artwork. Controlled and responsive web navigation, original click audio, native fonts/CJK and mobile Sheet. Sidebar layout is an explicit web composition; unsupported visual variants omitted.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Minecraft Sonner
items.description: Original Minecraft SystemToast skin and600ms squared motion; native ASCII/CJK wrapping and original in/out audio. Default palette, GUIscales1–3. Actions and rich layouts are composed web controls.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Minecraft Avatar
items.description: Original PlayerFaceExtractor head and optional hat with accessible Base UI Avatar loading/fallback composition.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Minecraft Input Group
items.description: Standard Input Group exports composed from original EditBox, multiline edit, Button and native text appearances. Addon alignment/group layout are web composition; default native visual sizes/variants only.

items.name: table
items.title: Minecraft Table
items.description: Standard semantic Table exports composed from original native list background, separators and bitmap text. Table layout and selection are web compositions.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Minecraft calendar
items.description: Explicit Minecraft constituent composition with actual DayPicker calendar semantics.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Minecraft date-picker
items.description: Explicit Minecraft constituent composition with actual DayPicker calendar semantics.

items.name: item
items.title: Minecraft Item
items.description: Ten standard shadcn Item exports with original compatible-world row layout, landscape thumbnail, hover join sprites, selection frames, ASCII/Unihex text, native clipping and activation audio. Only default visual variant and size; arbitrary content and action layouts remain compositions.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Minecraft Data Table
items.description: TanStack Table v9 columns/data with sorting, filtering, pagination, selection and visibility. Original native Table constituents; data-grid behavior is an explicit web composition.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Minecraft Carousel
items.description: Standard Embla Carousel API with original recipe-book ImageButton arrows and original click audio. Slide layout, gestures and vertical arrow rotation are explicit web compositions.

items.name: message
items.title: Minecraft Message
items.description: Conversation messages, composition and scrolling in one self-contained registry item.

items.name: form
items.title: Minecraft Form
items.description: Accessible forms with labels, validation and field composition.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Minecraft Code-Block
items.description: Standard current shadcn code-block APIs using original Minecraft font, palette, sprites or loading phases. Layout and web interactions compose native constituents; verified scope is recorded separately.

items.name: chart
items.title: Minecraft Chart
items.description: Full standard Recharts chart/config/tooltip/legend API plus original Minecraft FPS and profiler charts. Native plot pixels verified against unchanged original native renderers; generic Recharts charts are explicit web extensions.

items.name: trace

items.description: Standard current shadcn trace APIs using original Minecraft font, palette, sprites or loading phases. Layout and web interactions compose native constituents; verified scope is recorded separately.

items.name: spinner

items.description: Standard current shadcn spinner APIs using original Minecraft font, palette, sprites or loading phases. Layout and web interactions compose native constituents; verified scope is recorded separately.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Minecraft Native Select
items.description: Real HTML select with an original CycleButton closed visual; OS popup and multiple listbox remain platform-controlled.

items.name: marker
items.title: Minecraft Marker

items.name: input-otp

items.description: Standard shadcn API composed with verified Minecraft native constituents.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Minecraft questionnaire
items.description: Genuine @shadcn/react Questionnaire semantics with original Minecraft text, checkbox, input and button constituents.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Minecraft attachment
items.description: Original world-list row, item thumbnail/text constituents and button actions in an explicit file-attachment composition.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Minecraft Combobox
items.description: All standard Base UI Combobox exports plus Clear/ChipRemove, generic values, render functions, filtering, keyboard and multiple chips. Original EditBox, native Button, suggestion/menu text/surfaces; combobox and chip layout are web compositions.

items.name: trading
items.title: Trading
items.description: A selectable trade list with payment, result and original merchant feedback.

items.name: redstone-lamp-display
items.title: Redstone Lamp Display
items.description: Glyphs 0-9 and k as 3x5 walls of lit and unlit Redstone Lamps with block-atlas mip level 1, matching projected references at 8 px cells. Web adaptations: glyph composition with a one-column unlit gap, and a transparent backdrop.

items.name: fireworks
items.title: Fireworks
items.description: useFireworks() returns launch(anchor): one firework rocket (flight, trail and star explosion at the fixed seeds) on a shared pointer-transparent 480x640 canvas, with the native launch, large_blast and twinkle sounds on their ticks at the master volume, matching projected references at partialTick 0. Web adaptations: placement on the anchor, fixed seed, transparent backdrop, near sounds without distance delay, and sound only under prefers-reduced-motion.
